content.question: practical progress on room-temperature superconductors 2026
content.answer: The provided sources do not offer information on practical progress on room-temperature superconductors in 2026, specific research initiatives, funding and investment trends, or expert consensus on feasibility. One source mentions a claim in 2023 regarding a room-temperature superconductor under ambient pressure, which generated speculation [1]. Superconductors have been developed at Bell Labs [2], and high-temperature superconductors were first discovered in 1986 [3]. The commercial availability of high-temperature superconductors in the 2010s has been seen as promising for technologies like tokamaks [4]. Superconductors are also used in quantum computing to reduce error rates [7].
